captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a side-post cantilever arm with four distinct parts. It features a black vertical support post bolted to a rectangular base, which holds an orange shoulder link. Attached to the shoulder link is a matching orange forearm link, ending in a dark blue rectangular wrist plate with a central grey cylindrical face. The joints allow for horizontal rotational (revolute) movement at the shoulder, elbow, and wrist, projecting the arm assembly to one side.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery Python script for a side-post cantilever robotic arm. The model should include a grounded black support post on a rectangular base, connected to an orange shoulder link, an orange forearm link, and a blue wrist plate, all articulated via serial revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat box primitive with small cylinders for the bolts. The support post is created using a vertical cylinder swept or joined to a horizontal cap block. Create the orange arm segments by combining box primitives with rounded cylinder ends to form clean link geometries. Finally, attach a thin rectangular box for the wrist plate and a small cylinder for the wrist face, using local transformations to position each link relative to its joint origin.
